name: Shackleton Rim
note: Pole-facing crest of Shackleton's rim (crater center 10.5 km away), snapped to the local DEM maximum. Candidate Artemis/ILRS base region.

name: Shackleton Floor
note: Selected local DEM minimum on Shackleton crater floor. The cached interval reports no hourly Sun-centre visibility; this calculation does not establish permanent shadow or detect water ice.

name: Malapert Massif (Artemis area)
note: Selected Malapert-region DEM maximum. The displayed DEM-anchored coordinate defines the prediction; it is not a certified landing point.

name: Polar High Point
note: A local high point in the LOLA south-polar cap (above the 1737.4 km reference sphere), selected to explore high-elevation illumination and Earth visibility.

name: IM-1 Odysseus Site
note: Intuitive Machines IM-1 Odysseus landing region, Feb 2024, near Malapert A (approximate published coordinates; no DEM snap — it is a real landing site).

name: de Gerlache Rim
note: Rim crest of de Gerlache crater (~34 km), snapped to the local DEM maximum. Adjacent to the Artemis candidate region.

name: Haworth Rim
note: Rim crest of Haworth crater (~26 km), snapped to the local DEM maximum. Haworth floor is a classic permanently shadowed ice target.

name: Faustini Rim
note: Rim crest of Faustini crater (~39 km), snapped to the local DEM maximum. Deep, ancient, permanently shadowed interior.

name: Nobile Rim
note: Rim crest of Nobile crater (~73 km, central-peak crater), snapped to the local DEM maximum. Former VIPER rover exploration region.

name: Connecting Ridge
note: NASA Artemis III candidate region: the crest between the de Gerlache and Shackleton/Henson drainage, snapped to the local DEM maximum.

name: Connecting Ridge Extension
note: NASA Artemis III candidate region northeast of Connecting Ridge, snapped to the local DEM maximum.

name: Amundsen Rim
note: Rim crest of Amundsen crater (~105 km), snapped to the local DEM maximum. NASA Artemis III candidate region; classic volatile-science target south of the central peak.

name: Leibnitz Beta Plateau
note: NASA Artemis III candidate region on the Leibnitz Beta plateau west of Malapert, snapped to the local DEM maximum.

name: de Gerlache-Kocher Massif
note: NASA Artemis III candidate region: the massif between de Gerlache and Kocher craters, snapped to the local DEM maximum.
